newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 7.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 7. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Agriculture Minister Sjarifuddin Baharsjah has asked governors to make preparations for this year's drought. Some areas in the main island of Java have started to experience severe drought due to the delayed rainy season.

The Central Bank, Bank Indonesia, has promised to speed up credit financing procedures for national car manufacturer PT Timor Putra Nasional, controlled by President Suharto's youngest son Hutomo Mandala Putra.
Research and Technology Minister Jusuf Habibie has said Finland is considering buying CN-235 planes through a counter purchase.
